meta.one_liner: Everyone says 'buy the dip.' This tests it: buy 3% pullbacks in a bull market, sell +5% or after 10 days.
meta.explainer_md: The internet's favorite advice, made precise so it can actually be tested: when SPY or QQQ falls 3% or more over five days while still above its 200-day average (so the bull market is intact), buy. Take profit at +5%, or get out after 10 trading days, whichever comes first. Now you can see what 'buy the dip' really returned — and how it felt in 2020 and 2022.

spec.name: Buy the Dip
spec.description: SPY/QQQ down 3%+ in 5 days while above sma_200; exit +5% or 10 days.
